Return a list of [start,end,tags] for maximal merged ranges, ordered by start. Overlapping OR touching ranges merge transitively. tags is the sorted list of distinct tags from all nonempty original ranges merged into that range. Duplicate rows or repeated tags must not duplicate a tag. Input may be unsorted and endpoints may be negative. Do not mutate the input. The result for an empty input is []. Use only Python built-ins; give only the function, with no imports, I/O or surrounding explanation.
